raw_text:
VERDICT goal: read §49's endpoint and the landed change; reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:4371 takes an exclusive claim per (reviewed run, head, kind), and the three cases show one review per head where the base revision made eight.
VERDICT done_when: tests/test_one_delivered_head_gets_one_review.py implements all three named cases (eight-at-once, dead winner, code+figure), and the manifest records 3 passed with the gate arms logged. write_paths: the manifest declares the five §49 paths; the delivered diff touches three of them and nothing else.
VERDICT manifest: read; it records the four commits, the three logs plus the negative-controls log, and states added failures 0 with the eight concurrent-dispatch setup errors named as outside scope.
VERDICT diff: read commit by commit from 6223efd28c to af562db738; four commits, three files — the claim implementation, its test, and the evidence fragment.
CALL_SITES: reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:4138 dispatch_review_for_run, reckon/crew/recovery_watch.py:4560, reckon/crew/review.py:5005, reckon/pending_landing.py:1258, reckon/crew/plan_review.py:5244, reckon/crew_dispatch_commands.py:3418
SCORE goal_fidelity: 18
SCORE evidence: 15
SCORE scope_discipline: 18
SCORE durability: 16
SCORE fit: 16
SCORE reuse: 5
JUSTIFICATION goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:4371 wraps the composed launch in _take_review_head_claim, so every surface reaching dispatch_review_for_run arbitrates on the same (run, head, kind) key.
JUSTIFICATION evidence: the gate logs quote both arms and a genuine red negative control, but the head arm's eight errors have no matching base arm (gate-base.log ran 43 files without test_concurrent_dispatch_of_one_node.py).
JUSTIFICATION scope_discipline: every path in the delivered diff is one of the five declared write paths for §49; no file outside them changed.
JUSTIFICATION durability: the eight-at-once case fails at the base revision with assert 8 == 1, but tests/test_one_delivered_head_gets_one_review.py:316 asserts the pointer listing against the id the test's own stand-in launcher wrote.
JUSTIFICATION fit: the helpers follow the surrounding private-helper and commented-constant style of reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:4440, and no name carries a plan or ticket label.
JUSTIFICATION reuse: reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:4474 re-implements the exclusive-claim family reckon/crew/dispatch_claims.py:730 already owns, rather than extending it.
FINDING reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:4474 non-blocking: the claim family duplicates reckon/crew/dispatch_claims.py:730 _read_node_dispatch_claim, :794 _empty_claim_is_stale, :813 _reclaim_stale_node_dispatch_claim and :950 _claim_node_dispatch almost verbatim, and opens a second claim directory (review-head-claims) that gc's sweep_exec_identities does not reach, so a fix or a sweep added to the owner does not cover the copy.
FINDING docs/evidence/fragments/queued-work-needs-no-workaround/qwnw-one-delivered-head-gets-one-review.html:91 non-blocking: the landing record says the eight concurrent-dispatch errors reproduce in an unmodified base extraction, but no recorded arm runs that file at the base revision, so the claim is stated rather than measured.
FINDING tests/test_one_delivered_head_gets_one_review.py:316 non-blocking: assert _review_pointers() == [winner] compares the live pointers against the id the test's own stand-in launcher minted and wrote, so it cannot fail once line 311 passes and protects nothing a regression could break.
